local_angles: RMC 4-5-060 exemption: painting, nonstructural wood/vinyl siding and similar finish work exempt; not veneer, stucco or EIFS; not RCW 64.55 condo structures; permit required for exterior regulated work in WUI locations
Commerce RRP: certification required for renovation, repair or painting work on pre-1978 homes; WAC 365-230-360 firm certification

WAC 365-230-330 exterior: close doors/windows within 20 ft, ground cover 10 ft, vertical containment within 10 ft of property line; no open-flame burning; shrouded HEPA machines only; heat guns below 1,100 F
EPA: RRP generally not for owner-occupants doing own work, applies to rentals, home child care, flippers
